key_decisions.decision: Preserve the five-head count without inventing a fifth son.
Make the woman’s role visible while noting the compressed syntax.
Retain the difficult connections and the daughters; explain uncertainty in a note.
Retain the raid and deaths without resolving the uncertain direction of the raid.
Keep the daughter as the builder of all three places.
Preserve the uneven genealogy rather than inventing an explicit Rephah–Resheph link.
